name: 8x8 Inc
business_overview: 8x8, Inc. provides contact center, voice, video, chat, and enterprise-class application programmable interface (API) solutions worldwide. The company offers 8x8 Work, a unified communications-as-a-service solution that enable collaboration and business continuity across voice, video, chat, and messaging; and 8x8 Contact Center is a cloud-based contact center-as-a-service solution that customer engagement across voice, chat, email, and digital channels. It also provides 8x8 Engage, which extends digital engagement tools to non-traditional customer-facing employeessales, field service, financeenabling to deliver AI-informed customer experiences at desk, in the field or on the go; 8x8 Communications as a Service, a communications-as-a-service solutions that allow businesses to embed communications directly into digital experiences via communications APIs, including voice, SMS, rich messaging services, and additional digital and social channels; and solutions for Microsoft team users. The company markets its services through digital marketing, in-person and virtual events, peer reference and advocacy programs, localized and regional advertising, and partner and co-marketing initiatives. It serves small business, mid-market, enterprise customers, government agencies, and other organizations. 8x8, Inc. was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Campbell, California.

classification_meta.logic_summary: 8x8 provides cloud-based unified communications and contact center solutions as a subscription service.

narrative.text:
**Business & market dynamics:** The company is capitalizing on a structural shift toward usage-based cloud communications, with AI-driven features and the ongoing Fuze customer migration providing fresh growth vectors. Demand for integrated UCaaS/CCaaS platforms remains resilient as distributed work persists, and the broader video conferencing cohort is outperforming expectations, signaling a healthy end-market environment with favorable competitive positioning.

**Management strategy and execution:** Leadership is successfully pivoting the narrative from a debt-heavy past to an AI-led, platform-driven future. The team delivered a clean top- and bottom-line beat and issued above-consensus guidance, demonstrating operational discipline and credible foresight. Progress on the Fuze integration and a sharp stock market reaction reinforce growing confidence in execution, suggesting management has recaptured credibility after a period of restructuring.
